failureCauses.packages/cli/test/console-session.test.t: The unchanged July horizon receives no qualifying hour-stamped battle paper, as in S67; no field armies or contact are introduced by S68.
failureCauses.packages/cli/test/liveness-gate.test.ts: The same 18 non-succession breaches retain exactly the S67 fire counts; the sourced fifth succession is now inside around(5). Ruling 1 holds these contracts for the July build.
failureCauses.packages/cli/test/done-check.test.ts: The Phase 0 criterion fails on those same 18 liveness problems. The planted-mechanic positive control fails its prerequisite assertion that the unplanted baseline has no liveness problems.

reusedEvidence.reason: No simulation, pack, lockfile, save, fixture-save, checker or signature change; only the gate band and its cause ledger differ among measured non-test inputs. No reference rerun or done-check campaign.
